title: unify-sdks: consolidate auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go + v1.86.1 version bumps
author: Priya Patel
release_notes:
- Unify authentication and retry semantics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs.
- Improve streaming API ergonomics (consistent iterator/async iterator behavior and backpressure hints).
- Parity fixes for structured streaming events and error propagation.
- Version bumps: python/ts -> v1.86.1, go -> v0.45.2.
description:
Context: Multiple SDKs had diverging behavior around auth token refreshes, retry/backoff windows, and streaming ergonomics which caused subtle production bugs (double-retries, inconsistent cancellation behavior, and mismatched event shapes). This PR unifies the implementation and surface across Python, TypeScript, and Go so downstream integrations observe consistent behavior.

What I changed: consolidated the shared retry policy (exponential backoff with jitter, idempotency-aware retries) into the sdk-common layer; standardized token refresh hooks to a single async/sync contract; adjusted streaming client APIs so that: (1) sync iterator and async iterator produce the same event types, (2) connection-level errors are surfaced before partial events, and (3) clients receive backpressure hints via .suggested_batch_size where supported.

Scope: this PR touches package-specific wrappers in redwood-sdk-python, redwood-sdk-typescript, and redwood-sdk-go as well as the internal sdk-common module. The changes include small surface adjustments (method signatures) with default compatibility shims where possible.

Testing and validation: added end-to-end integration tests for token refresh under concurrent requests, retry unit tests (including idempotent vs non-idempotent path), and streaming conformance tests asserting event shapes, ordering, and cancellation semantics. Ran full CI (lint, unit, integration). Performed manual compatibility testing with an internal service that previously experienced double-retry incidents (SUP-5043).

Upgrade notes: consumers of the SDKs should see the same public methods in most cases. The only notable change is an optional additional parameter on StreamingClient.start_stream("..., options={suggest_backpressure: true}") for TypeScript; Python and Go provide an options struct with the new backpressure hint. These are optional and default to previous behavior. Version bumps are included for release.

Checklist:
- [x] Consolidate retry/auth logic in sdk-common
- [x] Implement optional backpressure hints for streaming
- [x] Add parity tests for streaming events
- [x] Update SDK version numbers and changelogs
- [x] CI green and reviewers approved

Related: ENG-8421 (unify retry semantics), ENG-8470 (streaming ergonomics), SUP-5043 (incident follow-up).
